daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Momentum Analysis with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a SQL query with window functions to calculate: (1) a 20-day moving average of closing price for each stock, (2) the rank of each stock by daily percentage change within its sector, and (3) the lag of the previous day's closing price to compute day-over-day volatility. Filter for the top 10 stocks by trading volume in the last 30 days. Return stock ticker, date, close price, moving average, rank, and volatility. Use CTEs to structure the query clearly.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Aggregation
daily_quests.description: Download NSW Road Crash Data (includes crash records with location, vehicle type, severity, weather conditions). Use pandas to: (1) identify and handle missing values in critical columns (e.g., crash severity, road type), (2) standardise date formats and extract year/month/day_of_week, (3) clean categorical data (remove whitespace, unify inconsistent values in vehicle type), (4) create a new feature: crash severity index (weighted score based on injury count and fatality count), (5) aggregate crashes by suburb and day-of-week to identify high-risk patterns, (6) export cleaned dataset and aggregated summary to CSV. Write comments explaining each cleaning decision.

daily_quests.title: Australian Wine Production: SQL Analysis + Python Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build an end-to-end pipeline: (1) In Python, fetch and clean Australian Wine Production Statistics (production volume, varietal type, region, year). Handle missing values, standardise region names, and convert production volumes to consistent units (tonnes). Export to a local SQLite database. (2) In SQL, query the database to calculate: cumulative production by region over time using window functions, year-over-year growth rate for each varietal, and rank regions by total production. (3) In Python, read SQL results and create a summary report: top 5 regions by growth, varietal concentration by region, and identify any data quality issues in the original source. Save findings to a markdown report.
